title: Slack MCP server (reference implementation)
summary: Reviewed and nothing recorded. The sources behind AVE-2026-0004 describe an attacker posting in a public Slack channel that 'a Slack MCP server' then reads, but neither names a package, and the advisory does not either. This identity appears only in an illustrative example lock, so no claim can be tied to it from the cited sources. A source that names this package and its channel-reading tools would settle ingests-untrusted-content.

unknown.note: Shown for 'a Slack MCP server' reading a public channel (thehackernews.com, CurXecute); the package is not identified, so not recorded for this purl.
